text: The Patriots absolutely dismantled the Raiders 45-17 at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, with Drake Maye putting on a clinic by accounting for five total touchdowns despite operating without his top receiver and with both starting cornerbacks sidelined—a performance that should quieter any lingering doubts about the offense's ability to execute in adverse circumstances. The victory came at a cost, however, as running back TreVeyon Henderson suffered an ankle injury and left tackle Will Campbell departed with what NFL Network sources believe to be a knee sprain, compounding an already injury-depleted roster that had already placed veteran receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday with a calf injury. Head Coach Mike Vrabel and the Raiders' Klint Kubiak offered their postgame perspectives on a lopsided affair that showcased New England's depth and resilience, even as the injury report suggests some potentially serious complications heading into the stretch run.
